## Technical Projects Built by Dubbaka Sathwik
- [INTELLI-Query](https://dubbakasathwik.in/projects/intelli-query-conversational-bi): Explore INTELLI-Query by Dubbaka Sathwik: a conversational BI app using Google Gemini, SQL.js, Node.js, and Chart.js to turn CSV prompts into SQL charts.
- [Nexora-AI](https://dubbakasathwik.in/projects/nexora-ai-multi-model-dashboard): Explore Nexora-AI by Dubbaka Sathwik: a React, Node.js, and MongoDB multi-model AI dashboard for side-by-side LLM comparison, consensus, and analytics.
- [MedLens](https://dubbakasathwik.in/projects/medlens-clinical-intelligence-platform): Explore MedLens by Dubbaka Sathwik: a Next.js and Node.js AI platform turning unstructured medical reports into FHIR-compliant records with provenance.
- [Cobra Core & Tech](https://dubbakasathwik.in/projects/cobra-core-tech): Explore Cobra Core & Tech, an AI-powered EdTech SaaS built by Dubbaka Sathwik using Node.js, MongoDB, and modern web tech for seamless student career growth.
- [FoodFlow Connect](https://dubbakasathwik.in/projects/foodflow-connect): FoodFlow Connect by Dubbaka Sathwik is a role-based React and Node.js food rescue web app connecting providers, NGOs, and consumers to minimize waste.
- [News Without the Noise](https://dubbakasathwik.in/projects/news-without-the-noise): Explore News Without the Noise, an AI-powered news dashboard by Dubbaka Sathwik that filters misinformation using Node.js, Gemini, and OpenAI technologies.
- [AI Hiring Assistant](https://dubbakasathwik.in/projects/ai-hiring-assistant): Explore Dubbaka Sathwik's AI Hiring Assistant: a full-stack Node.js app using Tesseract.js OCR and LLaMA 3.1 for certificate fraud detection and ranking.
- [VaultFlow](https://dubbakasathwik.in/projects/vaultflow): VaultFlow by Dubbaka Sathwik is a secure Android personal finance manager using Jetpack Compose, Gemini API, and Room database for local, private insights.
